articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Chain
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring a unified architecture that natively interleaves text, image, audio, and video reasoning within a single chain-of-thought pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements in complex scientific problem-solving benchmarks, scoring 92% on GPQA Diamond. This marks a shift from bolted-on multimodal adapters to truly integrated cross-modal inference.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's RT-4 Enables Robots to Generalize Manipulation Across Unseen Objects
articles.summary: DeepMind published results for RT-4, a vision-language-action model trained on a massive cross-embodiment dataset that allows robots to manipulate novel objects with zero-shot generalization. In real-world trials, a single policy controlled multiple robot form factors with an 87% task success rate on previously unseen household items. The work substantially narrows the sim-to-real transfer gap that has long plagued robotic manipulation research.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Under Permissive Open License, Challenges Proprietary Frontier Models
articles.summary: Meta open-sourced Llama 4, a 1.2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model that rivals GPT-5 and Gemini Ultra 2 on major benchmarks while remaining available under an Apache 2.0-style license. The release includes distilled variants at 8B and 70B active parameters, optimized for single-node inference. The move is expected to accelerate open-source AI development and intensify the debate around competitive dynamics between open and closed model ecosystems.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Commercial Atlas Electric With Autonomous Warehouse Deployment
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics announced the first large-scale commercial deployment of its electric Atlas humanoid robot, with logistics partner DHL rolling out 150 units across three distribution centers in the US and Germany. The robots autonomously handle irregular package sorting and palletizing using onboard vision and learned manipulation policies. This represents the most significant commercial humanoid deployment to date and a potential inflection point for humanoid robotics in logistics.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm-Class N14P Node for AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC commenced high-volume manufacturing on its N14P process node, which uses backside power delivery and gate-all-around nanosheet transistors to achieve a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over its N2 node. First customers include NVIDIA and Apple, with AI accelerator chips expected to ship in Q1 2027. The node is critical for sustaining the compute scaling roadmap that underpins frontier AI model training.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional Steering Vectors for Fine-Grained Model Alignment
articles.summary: Anthropic published a paper detailing constitutional steering vectors, a technique that applies learned activation-space directions at inference time to dynamically adjust model behavior along multiple alignment dimensions without retraining. The approach allows enterprise customers to configure safety-helpfulness tradeoffs for specific deployment contexts via a simple API parameter. Early evaluations show the method reduces over-refusal rates by 45% while maintaining safety benchmarks.

articles.title: Breakthrough Solid-State Battery from QuantumScape Achieves 600 Wh/kg in Production Cells
articles.summary: QuantumScape reported that its latest solid-state lithium-metal cells achieved 600 Wh/kg energy density in production-representative form factors, nearly doubling the density of current lithium-ion cells. The cells sustained over 1,000 fast-charge cycles with less than 10% capacity degradation. If scaled successfully with manufacturing partner Volkswagen, this could transform EV range economics and enable viable electric aviation for short-haul routes.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: First Compliance Audits Target Foundation Model Providers
articles.summary: The European Union's AI Office initiated its first formal compliance audits under the AI Act's provisions for general-purpose AI systems, targeting major foundation model providers including OpenAI, Google, and Mistral. Auditors are evaluating systemic risk assessments, compute reporting, and red-teaming documentation requirements. The enforcement actions are being closely watched globally as a template for AI governance and could influence regulatory frameworks in the US and Asia.
